result.explanation: Pinned FIFO retention: live residents may be replaced in place, while tombstones consume capacity until their final pin is released. New residents use FIFO admission and evict only the oldest unpinned resident.
result.mapping: State maps each resident key to value, pin count, tombstone flag, and FIFO position. Outputs expose FIFO order, pin counts, tombstones, status, and only live get values.
result.assumptions: Inputs satisfy the stated capacity, key, integer, and event constraints. Tombstone keys are sorted lexicographically for output.
result.holds: function holds(input,output){if(!Array.isArray(output)||output.length!==input.events.length)return false;for(let i=0;i<output.length;i++){let o=output[i],e=input.events[i];if(!o||!Array.isArray(o.order)||!o.pins||!Array.isArray(o.tombstones)||typeof o.status!=="string"||!("value"in o))return false;if(i===0&&e.type==="put"&&(o.order.length!==1||o.order[0]!==e.key))return false}return true}
result.program: function solve(x){let s=x.state||[],e=x.event,c=x.config.capacity,k=e.key,t=e.type,i=-1;for(let j=0;j<s.length;j++)if(s[j][0]===k){i=j;break}let z="ignored",v=null;if(t==="put"){if(i>=0){if(s[i][3])z="blocked";else{s[i][1]=e.value;z="stored"}}else{if(s.length>=c){let q=-1;for(let j=0;j<s.length;j++)if(s[j][2]===0){q=j;break}if(q<0)z="blocked";else{s.splice(q,1);s.push([k,e.value,0,0]);z="stored"}}else{s.push([k,e.value,0,0]);z="stored"}}}else if(t==="pin"){if(i>=0&&!s[i][3]){s[i][2]++;z="pinned"}}else if(t==="unpin"){if(i>=0&&s[i][2]>0){s[i][2]--;z="released";if(s[i][3]&&s[i][2]===0)s.splice(i,1)}}else if(t==="invalidate"){if(i<0)z="missing";else if(s[i][2]===0){s.splice(i,1);z="invalidated"}else{if(!s[i][3]){s[i][3]=1;z="invalidated"}}}else if(t==="get"){if(i>=0&&!s[i][3]){v=s[i][1];z="hit"}else z="miss"}let order=[],pins={},ts=[];for(let a of s){order.push(a[0]);pins[a[0]]=a[2];if(a[3])ts.push(a[0])}ts.sort();return{state:s,output:{order:order,pins:pins,status:z,tombstones:ts,value:v}}}
